acceptanceCriteria: {fail,pass,fail} at identical inputs -> INTERMITTENT with both first errors.
Changed test file blob between runs -> runs not pooled.
Fewer runs than threshold -> INSUFFICIENT, never DETERMINISTIC.
Intermittent test with expected-fail annotation -> EXPECTED_FAIL_NOT_DETERMINISTIC.
body:
Source: GitHub beamfall/corvint#798.

From Playwright JSON reports/receipts, pool runs only when identity inputs match (test file blob, config, application revision, project) and report per test DETERMINISTIC/INTERMITTENT/INSUFFICIENT with outcomes by run and differing first-error lines; flag EXPECTED_FAIL_NOT_DETERMINISTIC for intermittent tests carrying test.fail() and suggest skip/fixme with defect id or fixing the varying setup. Optionally feed the expected-fail obligation outcome so an intermittent expected-fail is neither credited nor treated as a fresh failure.
